Hi Sofia & David,

Great speaking with you both this morning — thanks for the time and the context on your payment reconciliation and settlement workflows. Quick recap from our end and a proposed next step:

Recap (30s):
- You’re evaluating ways to reduce per-transaction latency on reconciliation reports and to standardize downstream anomaly detection.
- Primary stakeholders: Sofia (payments ops), David (platform/engineering), and potentially a data science owner for ML monitoring.
- Success metric: reduce manual investigation time by ~30% and shrink end-to-end reconciliation latency.

Proposed next step:
We recommend a 30-min product demo / technical intro where we’ll cover: brief product overview, how we’d approach your reconciliation use case, and a low-level look at integrations and expected latency/cost tradeoffs.

Please pick one of these options that works for your team (we can also send a calendar invite once you confirm):
1) Tue, Apr 20 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
2) Wed, Apr 21 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT
3) Thu, Apr 22 — 11:30 AM–12:00 PM PT

Who should join from your side? I’ve cc’d Marissa (AE) and Jordan (Solutions Eng) — they’ll run the demo and can answer technical/integration questions.

Attachments: I’ve attached a one-pager and a short discovery notes PDF for reference.

Thanks,

Vanessa Ortiz
